stem: What can the reader infer about the author's father?

options.label: A
options.text: He came to appreciate the opportunity to share his past with his daughter.

options.label: B
options.text: He gave his daughter driving lessons because his wife insisted.

options.label: C
options.text: He concentrated better than his daughter when they talked.

options.label: D
options.text: He thought that talking to his daughter might help her drive better.
